name: Create Activity Template (Ultra Minimal)
description: Create activity templates with minimal overhead - one-shot template generation

task_steps.description: Create a complete activity template JSON in one step

prompt.template:
Register the template at /tmp/{{templateId}}.json with the backend.

Use register_activity_template tool:
- file_path: /tmp/{{templateId}}.json
- register_with_metabob: true

Then write success message to /tmp/{{templateId}}-SUCCESS.txt:
Template {{templateName}} registered successfully as {{templateId}}
